mapper.sql: SELECT g.title_img as titleImg, g.des as des, CASE WHEN g.game_type = 0 THEN CONCAT( system_name, carrier_name ) ELSE CONCAT( group_name, server_name ) END as qufu, o.sale_price as salePrice, g.id as goodsId, o.id as orderId, o.create_time as createTime, o.oderstatus as orderStatus, s1.nick_name as nickName, IF(s1.phonenumber='', '', CONCAT(LEFT(s1.phonenumber, 3), '****', RIGHT(s1.phonenumber,4))) AS dephone, g.shiming as shiming, g.create_time as goodsCreateTime, g.account_type as accountType, o.pay_record_id as payRecordId, o.no as no, count(b.id) as browseNum, p.pay_end_time as payEndTime, o.cancel_time as cancelTime, o.finish_time as finishTime, o.goods_amount as goodsAmount, o.guarantee_type as guaranteeType, o.close_time as closeTime, o.guarantee_amount as guaranteeAmount, o.refund_amount as refundAmount, o.paid_amount as paidAmount, o.after_sale_id as afterSaleId, o.after_sale_value as afterSaleValue, o.after_sale_remark as afterSaleRemark FROM order_rec o LEFT JOIN goods_info g ON g.id = o.accountid LEFT JOIN sys_user s1 on s1.user_id=g.create_id left join pay_record p on p.id=o.pay_record_id left join goods_browse b on b.goods_id=g.id
